issues: Original dream rules consider both alleged truthfulness of dream outcomes and the dream's content/sensory themes. The two are different targets, not interchangeable confirmations.
Jupiter or Venus in ninth, potent and not afflicted, allegedly give dreams corresponding to actual events; the source provides no forecast window, target event registry, hit denominator or controls.
Malefics in ninth allegedly give dreams wholly deceitful; this is a retrospective and untested dream-to-event correspondence claim.
Benefics in ninth but debilitated/afflicted permit ambiguous dreams both sometimes true and sometimes false, so matching one detail alone could not establish accurate prediction.
When no planet occupies ninth the author uses ninth cusp sign and its ruler as fallback, rather than assuming no dreams occur.

The content categories Saturn agriculture/caves/burial/fear, Jupiter gentry/church, Mars fights/war/animals/fires, Sun gold/status, Venus pleasure/clothes/smells, Mercury books/journeys/youth, Moon water/sea/flying, overlap significantly.
Moon with Saturn is given as a conditional horrifying-dream exception; this is not a clinical nightmare or trauma diagnosis.
Spirits, demons and prophecy language in the historical original concerns perceived dream content or claimed symbolism, not independently established supernatural facts.
No real human dream reports, independent pre-registered dream dates, outcome verification, comparison subjects or blind testing occurred.
Original chapter source ends bottom PDF648 but its trailing printed word 'The' is a catchword leading to the separate substantive UNNUMBERED tenth-house introduction PDF649.
No royal rank, supernatural ability, clinical sleep or mental-health classification may be inferred from natal planets based on these unvalidated historical claims.
The next separately numbered printed CHAP CXLIIII on honors begins later PDF649 after the unnumbered tenth-house introduction; must not skip the intervening material.
Photographic provenance and record mapping tests establish historical-source integrity, not the truth of predictive astrology.
